name: FruitoType
tagline: Generates a unique procedural fruit illustration from your face and personality answers.
problem: The builder wanted a playful mix of speculative biology and personal identity.
solution: Webcam facial landmark analysis and a personality form feed a procedural SVG generator that designs a fruit for each person.
demo_moment: Team-described: scan your face and watch your fruit appear.

why_it_stood_out.claim: A solo build focused on visual craft.

lessons: A delightful personal output wins design judges.
